name: 30336 · Atlanta, GA
findings: ZIP 30336 (Atlanta) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30336 (Atlanta) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30336 (Atlanta) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 29.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
